en: Stalling twice in a row: no effect, and the onlookers lose patience.

en: Strike the claim he is about to make this round.

en: If you are exposed, refuted or whiff a rebuttal this round, Arthur smooths it over. Otherwise it is wasted.

zh-TW: 妳知道這說不通。論證較高，但會留下裂紋，也可能被拆穿。

en: He just let something slip. No evidence needed; this round only.

en: His guard is down. Land a link this round to break him!

en: On the back foot: read him right once to steady yourself.
